emails.subject: Can you review the migration doc before Thursday?
emails.body:
Hi — I finished the draft of the storage migration plan. Section 4 is the part I'm least sure about; if the rollback window is too tight, say so and I'll rework it. I need to send it to Dana by Thursday morning.

Thanks,
Sarah

emails.subject: Moving our 1:1 to Wednesday
emails.body: Something came up Tuesday afternoon. Can we move our 1:1 to Wednesday at 2? If that doesn't work I can do Thursday morning instead. Let me know what's easier.

emails.subject: photos from the weekend
emails.body:
Finally got around to sorting these. The ones from the lake came out much better than I expected. Let me know if you want the full-size versions and I'll put them somewhere you can grab them.

Also — are you still up for the thing in October?

emails.subject: Question about the invoice line items
emails.body: Two of the line items on the last invoice don't match what we agreed in the SOW — items 3 and 7. Could you take a look and let me know whether that's a billing error or something I've misunderstood? Happy to jump on a call.

emails.subject: Revised quote attached
emails.body: Attached is the revised quote reflecting the changes we discussed on site — the joist work is in, the deck extension is out. Give me a call if you want to walk through any of it before deciding.

emails.subject: Following up on our conversation
emails.body: Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As promised, I've spoken with the department and we can accommodate the schedule change starting next term. Could you confirm in writing so I can pass it along to the office?

emails.subject: Documents needed before Friday
emails.body: To file on time I'll need the signed disclosure and the two bank statements we discussed. Friday is the practical deadline — after that we're into the following month's docket. Reply here and I'll send a secure upload link.

emails.subject: your mother's birthday
emails.body: I'm trying to organise something for your mother's birthday and I want it to be a surprise, so don't mention it. Are you free the weekend of the 14th? If enough of us can make it I'll book the back room somewhere.

emails.subject: Following up — the platform role we discussed
emails.body:
Following up on our call last Tuesday. The team came back and they'd like to move to a technical conversation. I pushed back on the compensation band you mentioned and there is some room there.

Are you still interested? If not, tell me and I'll close it out — no hard feelings.
emails.note: Individually written recruiter follow-up referencing a real prior call. Primary under rule 1, but reasonable people label unsolicited recruiting as Promotions.

emails.subject: Re: Re: incident postmortem owner
emails.body: Picking this thread back up. Nobody has claimed the postmortem and it's been a week. I'll write it if you'd rather not, but you were closest to the failure so it'd be better coming from you. Say either way today?
